blocks_9: Narrow sidebars truncate person names and squeeze conversation content at 760 px.
Important supporting text is repeatedly only 11-12 points, and onboarding footers use extremely long lines.
Spacing and hierarchy need another pass: settings ends through a control, meeting times are understated, and short call transcripts float below large blank areas.
Thread grouping and preview selection are too subtle; attachment previews and the dark QR quiet zone need refinement.

top_issues.issue: The narrow layout allocates too much width to navigation and loses useful identity information.
top_issues.evidence: At 760 px, the conversation begins at x=296, leaving 464 px. Names such as Katherine Johnson truncate around x=216 in Calls; several chat names truncate before the timestamps.
top_issues.fix: At widths below 900 px reduce the list to about 200 px plus the 64 px rail, allow a collapsible list, and reserve at least 120 px of name space before call actions.

top_issues.issue: Supporting information is consistently too small for comfortable desktop scanning.
top_issues.evidence: Native-size screenshots show approximately 11-12 point timestamps, navigation captions, keyboard help and recovery copy, versus 14 point messages. The composer help occupies only about 12 px of visible line height near y=779.
top_issues.fix: Use 13 point supporting text with 18 px line height. Keep 11 point text for genuinely incidental badges; use 13 point medium weight for actionable recovery information.

top_issues.issue: The settings viewport ends through a partially visible next control.
top_issues.evidence: The dialog spans y=49-722. A fragment of the next checkbox remains at y=696 and the scroll thumb ends at y=455, so substantial content continues below. The bottom fade barely explains this.
top_issues.fix: End the viewport between rows with 16 px bottom padding. Add a clear bottom scroll affordance or section navigation; retain a visible scrollbar track and 24 px between sections.

top_issues.issue: The meeting time lacks the prominence needed for the primary scheduling decision.
top_issues.evidence: The meeting title is about 18 points at x=394,y=17; its time and countdown share a roughly 12 point subtitle at y=34. Organizer and Online labels below receive 14 point treatment.
top_issues.fix: Place the day and 15:06-15:51 time in a 15 point medium-weight row below the title, then show the countdown in a separate 13 point label. Keep Join adjacent.

top_issues.issue: Some message lines are too long for sustained reading.
top_issues.evidence: The channel content runs approximately x=447-1200, a 750 px measure containing over 100 characters before wrapping in the Performance check post. The 1920 px chat uses a narrower bounded column more effectively.
top_issues.fix: Limit prose to roughly 640-680 px or 80-90 characters, retain 14 point body text with 20 px line height, and align card contents to that measure.

top_issues.issue: Short meeting transcripts float below a large blank band.
top_issues.evidence: In call-docked the header ends at y=132 and the beginning marker appears at y=308, leaving roughly 170 px blank before any conversation context. The 380 px view also has a roughly 100 px blank band.
top_issues.fix: Top-align short transcript history with 24-32 px padding below the header, or make the bottom anchoring visually explicit. Reduce padding around system events to 12-16 px.

top_issues.issue: The onboarding footer is a very long, tiny line.
top_issues.evidence: At 1280 px the footer runs approximately x=212-1068, about 856 px for roughly 160 characters, using about 12 point type. The main card is only 470 px wide.
top_issues.fix: Set the footer to 13 point text with 18 px line height and a maximum width of 560-600 px, wrapping into two or three lines. Leave 32 px between it and the card or demo button.

top_issues.issue: The QR code has a marginal quiet zone on its white backing.
top_issues.evidence: The black QR bounding box is approximately x=108-271,y=272-435. White backing begins around x=96,y=260. With roughly 4 px modules, the 12 px inset is about three modules; rounded corners reduce the corner margin further.
top_issues.fix: Provide at least 16 px of uninterrupted white margin on all four sides, preferably 20 px to clear the rounded corners. Keep the code black on white.

top_issues.issue: Fixed thumbnail boxes make very wide and tall attachments difficult to inspect.
top_issues.evidence: Three preview cells are about 144x96 px. The 3072x256 image renders as an approximately 140x12 px strip, while the 256x3072 image is about 8x92 px.
top_issues.fix: Retain aspect-fit previews but add a clearly visible expand affordance and show the original filename alongside dimensions. Use a subtle 1 px outline around the actual image bounds so tiny previews remain identifiable.

top_issues.issue: Thread-card separation is faint, especially in dark mode.
top_issues.evidence: Sampled card stroke #d0d1d6 against white is 1.52:1. Dark #3a3b42 against card #25262b is 1.35:1. These grouping lines are decorative, so this alone is not a WCAG failure.
top_issues.fix: Increase grouping-stroke contrast modestly to #b7b9c1 in light and #555863 in dark, or add 16 px inter-card spacing and a clearer header inset. Keep functional field outlines at their existing stronger contrast.

top_issues.issue: Explanatory copy dominates the calling page.
top_issues.evidence: The main-pane join block occupies y=78-174, followed by explanatory prose and capability rows through y=350, or y=405 when narrow. Actual people and call buttons remain confined to the sidebar.
top_issues.fix: Use a concise 13 point, two-line explanation under the join field and place the capability details in the existing disclosure. Give recent people a 15 point heading and more prominent call actions.

top_issues.issue: The selected recipient has less visual weight than an unselected suggestion.
top_issues.evidence: Grace Hopper appears in a roughly 143x32 px chip near y=185. Barbara Liskov occupies a 472x44 px selected result at y=281. The confirmation button names Grace, but the dominant highlight is on Barbara.
top_issues.fix: Add a 13 point medium-weight To label, use a 36 px recipient chip with a 14 point name, and clearly label the search results Add another person. Preserve a separate keyboard-focus treatment for suggestions.

top_issues.issue: The preview zoom selection is easy to miss.
top_issues.evidence: Fit and 100% are adjacent approximately 56x28 px segments. Selection relies largely on a neutral fill, close to the adjacent control and toolbar colours.
top_issues.fix: Use a 2 px accent underline or accent outline for the active segment, with 13 point semibold selected text. Keep both segments at least 32 px tall.
